label: abide 表型/刺激提取
description: Extract and merge ABIDE phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads ABIDE phenotype CSV files, standardizes diagnosis labels, selects columns, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing ABIDE phenotype CSV files (directory); phenotype_file: Direct path to ABIDE phenotype CSV file (file); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

parameters.label: columns
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns to select (default: all common columns)
parameters.usage: 参数说明直接来自 skills/abide-skill/scripts/extract_abide_phenotype.py:107。平台仅转发已登记选项；默认值和取值限制见本方法定义。

parameters.label: missing-threshold
parameters.description: Drop columns with more than this fraction of missing values (default: 0.5)
